desc.en: A carnivorous beast that serves the king of beasts. One could say it's like a pet dog, but it's quite obvious that this is not a pleasant creature. It will relentlessly attack any enemies ordered by its master, leaving not a single trace.
desc.ja: 獣の王に従う肉食獣。人間でいうところの飼い犬に当たるが、見た目の通りそんなに可愛いものではない。主の命令が下り次第、眼前の敵を跡形もなく蹂躙する
